text:
Maria K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners and timelines for the remediation items + the eval/test additions that came out of the incident.
Derek: Agreed. Can we list owners here and call out immediate vs medium-term?
Maria K: Immediate (1-2w): fix retry backoff config, add KV eviction guardrails, add targeted promptset failing example. Medium (3-6w): regression suite expansion, small load test, chaos drill.
Jon S: I can own the retry backoff and KV guardrails. ETA: end of next week (2026-04-03).
Derek: I'll take the promptset curation and add the failing examples to the evals repo. ETA: 1 week.
Sophia: I'll take the regression suite expansion and the small-scale load test. Need to sync on infra cost. Targeting 3 weeks.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: incident-526-restart deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T09:12:00Z
Maria K: For the regression suite: prioritize sequences that hit long-tail kv eviction patterns and repeated short prompts. Add at least 12 prompt variants.
Derek: Quick question — do we want those prompt variants as a separate promptset or appended to the existing regression promptset?
Maria K: Separate promptset called "postmortem-526-failures" so we can A/B and roll back easily.
Jon S: For KV guardrail, I'll add a metric alert and a mitigation script. Snippet here:
```
# monitor kv evictions
cron: "*/5 * * * *"
cmd: ./tools/kv_eviction_watch --threshold 0.05
```
Derek: Nice. For the failing example reporting, I'll add a test that asserts output stability for the key prompt family. If flakiness, it opens a ticket in the evals board.
Sophia: Load test plan: 10k concurrent requests distributed across 3 model variants, 5 min ramp, capture tail latency P95/P99 + token-cost. Will draft in the load-tests/ folder.
Maria K: Also add a chaos drill: simulate partial pod restart + region fallback. Run it after regression suite and load test, target date in 5 weeks.
Jon S: Owners + acceptance criteria writeup: I'll draft a one-pager and ping infra for required capacity.
Derek: Can we add an automated nightly eval job that runs the new promptset against current pinned models and reports regressions to #eng-ml? Proposed cron: `0 4 * * *` - runs against stable branch.
Maria K: Yes. Make it gated so it doesn't spam — only open alerts on >3 failing examples or delta > 2% regression.
oncall-bot: Calendar: Chaos drill scheduled tentatively on 2026-04-28 16:00 UTC (pending confirmations)
Sophia: One more ask — link the remediation ticket to the postmortem and include runbook steps for oncall in case it recurs.
Maria K: Good call. I'll create the parent JIRA and link all child TODOs (retry backoff, kv guardrail, promptset, regression, load test, chaos drill).
Jon S: I'll add the acceptance tests to the CI pipeline and a PR template for future incident-driven promptsets.
Derek: If no objections, I'll open PRs for the promptset and nightly eval job today.
Maria K: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners/times and close the loop once the PRs land. Please add any follow-ups to the thread. :thumbsup:
Sophia: Ack — will post load test plan by EOD tomorrow.
Derek: PRs opened: evals#342 and infra#128.
Maria K: Closing note — let's make the chaos drill recurring quarterly if the pattern persists. Tagging @here in eng-oncall for visibility.
